text: Full load rejection to house load: the aux system shall be supplied from the generator via the UAT and remain in stable operation for at least 60 minutes (ER-04.09). The UAT taps, MV bus voltage and frequency (47.5 to 52.5 Hz) shall be checked in the load rejection case of the stability study; no protective trip of the aux system shall occur for the frequency and voltage swing of the case.
